title: Meta removes AI image generator following privacy and consent backlash
description: Meta has suspended its Muse Image AI feature just days after launch following widespread criticism over its use of public Instagram accounts without explicit consent. The opt-out system drew backlash from creators, talent agencies, and SAG-AFTRA, prompting Meta to withdraw the feature.
